purpose: Define minimum lineage metadata for future evidence producers; this contract does not retroactively authenticate existing browser reports.

required_fields.skill_version: semantic version of the skill under test
required_fields.source_commit: full source commit SHA or explicit null for uncommitted local runs
required_fields.checks: array of named checks with PASS or FAIL outcomes

trust_rules: A state hash is a fingerprint, not a signature.
A report is not proof of execution unless its producer and execution environment are independently trusted.
Provider-model execution must identify the provider and model version and must not expose credentials.
Missing lineage fields must be reported as unknown, never inferred.
